style_name_cn: 暗黑工业史诗复仇风（维伦纽瓦巨物底色 × 黑泽明风雪动势 × 昆丁/朴赞郁暴烈反杀特写）

prefer: 24mm low-angle 0.3m trunk-shot looking up at oppressor or monumental mecha/beast
40mm locked or constant-speed push along depth axis for two-hander confrontation
85mm grazing-light macro insert on metallic/bone props before sudden action
2.0m high-angle downward pressure shot after power reversal
camera_grammar.horizon_rule: Place horizon at upper 1/8 (mud/ground oppression) or lower 1/8 (monumental tower/mecha/wolf scale), never 1/2 center split.
camera_grammar.multi_person_blocking: Arrange 3+ figures in a depth-axis wedge (foreground left/right to midground center to background), never a flat horizontal line.

lighting.key_quality: hard rim backlight through atmospheric medium (rain, steam, snow, ash)
lighting.key_ratio: 6:1 (8:1 on violent impact beats by cutting fill light)
lighting.depth_medium: visible rain streaks, pressurized steam, or blowing snow starting at 3 meters, creating a 2-stop tonal gradient toward the background

industrial_slum_and_sewer.dominant: asphalt slate-grey, wet cast-iron black, dark mud brown
industrial_slum_and_sewer.accent: molten amber-gold dragonfire and warm halogen sodium orange
industrial_slum_and_sewer.saturation: low-mid (high purity on amber fire accent)

imperial_palace_and_boudoir.dominant: obsidian shadow black, dark walnut brown, gunmetal grey
imperial_palace_and_boudoir.accent: deep arterial crimson velvet and burnished imperial gold

northern_glacier_and_wolf_valley.dominant: glacier cyan-grey, frost bone-white, basalt black
northern_glacier_and_wolf_valley.accent: volcanic magma gold, emerald geothermal mist, blood red
northern_glacier_and_wolf_valley.saturation: low on snow/rock, high on fire/blood

weather_on_body_rule: Weather must physically alter surfaces: rain-soaked fabric clinging to skin, dark mud splattered on knuckles and cheekbones, white frost clumping on eyelashes and fur collars, sweat and steam glistening on scarred skin.

performance_register.oppressors: Park Chan-wook polite cruelty with a one-beat delayed facial reaction when tables turn
performance_register.protagonist: Villeneuve/Kurosawa compressed physical endurance; minimal speech, heavy breathing, decisive 0.8-1.2s single-strike burst followed by 1.5s still aftermath

what_this_is_not: NO cyberpunk neon pink/cyan/purple LED strips
NO floating blue holographic UI screens or sci-fi laser grids
NO glossy clean plastic armor or spotless modern fabrics
reference_prompt_suffix_en: Style lock: dark steampunk industrial mythic realism (Villeneuve monumental atmospheric scale + Kurosawa tactile weather-on-body grit + Park Chan-wook/Tarantino grazing-light material sharpness). Weathered cast iron, oxidized brass, rain/oil/mud tactile surface wear, high-contrast 6:1 directional lighting. Strictly NO cyberpunk neon LEDs, NO glossy plastic, NO floating blue holograms.
